data.one_liner: Provides a widget to render and hit‑test children outside their parent bounds.
data.what_it_does: DeferPointer lets a child widget be painted and hit‑tested outside the bounds of its parent by delegating these tasks to a DeferredPointerHandler higher in the tree. It works like an Overlay but with finer control over the target area and optional top‑painting.
use_when: You need dropdowns, menus, or panels that extend beyond their parent without manual layer management
You require precise hit‑testing for widgets positioned outside their original bounds
avoid_when: The built‑in Overlay already satisfies your needs
The UI is simple and does not need out‑of‑bounds rendering
strengths: Simple API with just two widgets
Granular control over which ancestor handles painting and hit‑testing
weaknesses: Adds an extra widget layer which may affect performance in very large trees
Small ecosystem and limited community support
